<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="180%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="8" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".14"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="soft" x="-40%" y="-40%" width="180%" height="180%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="22"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F6F6F6"/>

  <!-- branded profile header -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="225" fill="#D52B1E"/>
  <circle cx="332" cy="28" r="88" fill="#F68E5A" opacity=".62" filter="url(#soft)"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="165" r="90" fill="#FDC82F" opacity=".52" filter="url(#soft)"/>
  <circle cx="218" cy="102" r="52" fill="#FFEA28" opacity=".26" filter="url(#soft)"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <text x="19" y="22" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
  <line x1="319" y1="18" x2="319" y2="22" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="323" y1="16" x2="323" y2="22" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="327" y1="14" x2="327" y2="22" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="331" y1="12" x2="331" y2="22" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M342 18 Q347 13 352 18 M344 21 Q347 18 350 21" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.6"/>

  <rect x="363" y="15" width="16" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="384" y="16" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- header controls -->
  <polyline points="27,57 18,66 27,75" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="45" y="72" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">My profile</text>
  <circle cx="352" cy="66" r="19" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".18"/>
  <circle cx="352" cy="60" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <ellipse cx="352" cy="72" rx="8" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>

  <!-- avatar -->
  <circle cx="78" cy="143" r="48" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".25"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="143" r="39" fill="#F7D8AB" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="133" r="11" fill="#D52B1E"/>
  <ellipse cx="78" cy="157" rx="19" ry="13" fill="#D52B1E"/>
  <circle cx="107" cy="174" r="13" fill="#FFEA28" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <polyline points="101,174 105,178 113,169" fill="none" stroke="#D52B1E" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <text x="139" y="132" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="22" font-weight="800" fill="#FFFFFF">Sofia Martinez</text>
  <text x="139" y="157" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Golden member</text>
  <rect x="139" y="169" width="113" height="27" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".2"/>
  <text x="155" y="187" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">2,480 points</text>

  <!-- content sheet -->
  <rect x="0" y="207" width="390" height="551" rx="30" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#shadow)"/>

  <text x="24" y="240" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Personal information</text>
  <text x="24" y="260" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#8B8B8B">Keep your details up to date</text>

  <!-- email field -->
  <text x="24" y="284" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#525252">Email address</text>
  <rect x="20" y="291" width="350" height="45" rx="15" fill="#F6F6F6" stroke="#DADADA"/>
  <text x="36" y="319" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">sofia.martinez@email.com</text>
  <polyline points="345,306 352,313 345,320" fill="none" stroke="#8B8B8B" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- phone field -->
  <text x="24" y="358" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#525252">Mobile number</text>
  <rect x="20" y="365" width="350" height="45" rx="15" fill="#F6F6F6" stroke="#DADADA"/>
  <text x="36" y="393" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">+1 (415) 555-0187</text>
  <polyline points="345,380 352,387 345,394" fill="none" stroke="#8B8B8B" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- account options -->
  <text x="24" y="446" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Account</text>

  <!-- vouchers -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="458" width="350" height="50" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="47" cy="483" r="17" fill="#FFF3B0"/>
    <rect x="38" y="476" width="18" height="13" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#D52B1E" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="42" y1="480" x2="52" y2="480" stroke="#D52B1E" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="76" y="480" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">My vouchers</text>
    <text x="76" y="497" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#8B8B8B">12 available</text>
    <rect x="323" y="470" width="30" height="25" rx="13" fill="#D52B1E"/>
    <text x="338" y="487" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">12</text>
  </g>
  <line x1="76" y1="518" x2="370" y2="518" stroke="#EBEBEB" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- payment -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="519" width="350" height="50" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="47" cy="544" r="17" fill="#F6F6F6"/>
    <rect x="37" y="537" width="20" height="14" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#525252" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="38" y1="541" x2="56" y2="541" stroke="#525252" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <polyline points="346,537 353,544 346,551" fill="none" stroke="#8B8B8B" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>
  <line x1="76" y1="579" x2="370" y2="579" stroke="#EBEBEB" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- address -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="580" width="350" height="50" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="47" cy="605" r="17" fill="#F6F6F6"/>
    <circle cx="47" cy="601" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#D52B1E" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polyline points="38,601 47,614 56,601" fill="none" stroke="#D52B1E" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="76" y="603" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Saved address</text>
    <text x="76" y="620" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#8B8B8B">1250 Market Street, San Francisco</text>
    <polyline points="346,598 353,605 346,612" fill="none" stroke="#8B8B8B" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>
  <line x1="76" y1="640" x2="370" y2="640" stroke="#EBEBEB" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- settings -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="641" width="350" height="48" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="47" cy="665" r="17" fill="#F6F6F6"/>
    <circle cx="47" cy="665" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#525252" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="47" y1="653" x2="47" y2="657" stroke="#525252" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="47" y1="673" x2="47" y2="677" stroke="#525252" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="35" y1="665" x2="39" y2="665" stroke="#525252" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="55" y1="665" x2="59" y2="665" stroke="#525252" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="76" y="671" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Settings</text>
    <polyline points="346,658 353,665 346,672" fill="none" stroke="#8B8B8B" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- lower controls -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="696" width="168" height="42" rx="21" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D52B1E" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="104" y="722" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#D52B1E">About the app</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="198" y="696" width="172" height="42" rx="21" fill="#D52B1E"/>
    <text x="284" y="722" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Log out</text>
  </g>

  <rect x="0" y="758" width="390" height="86" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#shadow)"/>

  <g>
    <polygon points="39,786 49,778 59,786 57,786 57,798 42,798 42,786" fill="none" stroke="#8A8A8A" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="49" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#8A8A8A">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>

    <line x1="135" y1="795" x2="142" y2="802" stroke="#8A8A8A" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="128" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#8A8A8A">Offers</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="187" y="779" width="22" height="18" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#8A8A8A" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <circle cx="194" cy="788" r="2" fill="#8A8A8A"/>
    <circle cx="202" cy="788" r="2" fill="#8A8A8A"/>
    <text x="198" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#8A8A8A">Orders</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="301" cy="786" r="10" fill="#D52B1E"/>
    <circle cx="301" cy="782" r="3.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <ellipse cx="301" cy="792" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="301" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#D52B1E">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
